crossRefs.note: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Yahweh I was not known to them.
“Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting…
This is what Yahweh, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last…
For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory…
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come…
“I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’ ”
translations.bsb: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
translations.kjv: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent
translations.asv: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
